description: M.M. Gunaratna Manike and Others v. R.M.R. Warnakulasuriya M.M. Gunaratna Manike and Others v. R.M.R. Warnakulasuriya View More before A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: M.M. Gunaratna Manike and Others v. R.M.R. Warnakulasuriya M.M. Gunaratna Manike and Others v. R.M.R. Warnakulasuriya View More
keywords: Plaintiff sought a declaration of title to certain lots, claiming inadvertent delivery of wrong lots by the Magistrate\'s Court. District Court found the defendant was not the tenant cultivator of the relevant paddy fields and ordered ejectment. Held - Court found the District Court\'s findings entirely consistent with the evidence and declined to interfere; therefore, Appeal of the defendant-appellant dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
